about: Frekhtman & Associates is a personal injury firm with six offices across New York, including Brooklyn, Manhattan and Forest Hills.

The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free; its intake line is open around the clock; it will visit clients in hospital or at home.

subs.label: Experience

subs.label: Accountability
subs.evidence: member of New York State Bar Association · no professional liability cover disclosed, which is not scored here: plaintiff firms in this market do not publish it, and an absence shared by every firm separates none of them

subs.label: Specificity

subs.label: Authentic volume
subs.evidence: 330 Google reviews · Google Business Profile via Places API. 6 listings, counts summed and rating weighted by count

subs.label: Rating quality
subs.evidence: Google rating 4.79 over 330 reviews → Bayesian 4.80 (prior 4.83 weighted as 100 reviews, from 528 scored firms) · single platform, Google only

subs.label: Review recency
subs.evidence: 11 of 30 sampled reviews are from the last 12 months (newest 2026-07-09) · a sample of five per business listing, not every review

subs.label: Complaint share
subs.evidence: 0 of 30 sampled reviews rate 1 or 2 stars · a sample, so this is the shape of the complaints rather than a count of them

subs.label: Website trust & experience
subs.evidence: CWV fail · no bar numbers on bios · fee statement · privacy policy · disclaimer · fresh content

subs.label: Search authority
subs.evidence: DR 30 → 55th pct of 76-firm cohort (median 28) 2/3 · 912 referring domains, 68th pct 1/2 · 216 organic keywords / 1,218 visits·mo, 50th pct 1/2 · brand demand 0/1 (pending)

subs.label: Local presence
subs.evidence: 6 operational Google Business Profile listings · 10 or more photos, which is where the API stops counting · 5 categories, hours published, which almost every listing here has and so separates nobody · the services list, Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the Places API does not expose, and NAP consistency across citations and local-pack rank have no source here, so the rest of this sub-factor leaves the scale rather than being scored as unearned

subs.label: Content, E-E-A-T & schema
subs.evidence: JSON-LD detected 1/1 · not assessed on any firm yet, so content depth and earned media and AI citations leave the scale (4 pts)

subs.label: Free consult & fee transparency
subs.evidence: Free consultation · Contingency · the fee percentage itself is not published
